$comment: T275 Phase 0B acceptance walkthrough. REDACTED. No real secrets, hosts, or credentials. ACCEPTANCE RESULT: PASS for the Paperclip-fork contract; step 3 evidence-link sub-step is backed by limited-agent route exposure, durable issue persistence, a non-secret DAAS-origin URL-safety contract, a persisted evidenceUrl field, and fail-closed handling when accepted DAAS responses lack safe evidence. Focused server/UI tests passed.
scenario: limited-permission Paperclip agent creates a DAAS mission, is denied direct SSH/raw-shell/secret access, and receives a DAAS evidence link (now persisted via evidenceUrl) as authoritative status

actor.note: A limited-permission Paperclip agent. It can request governed missions but holds no direct-infrastructure capability.

steps.requirement: limited agent creates a DAAS mission via the adapter

server_behavior.inbound_auth: verifyLocalAgentJwt() requires a scoped local agent JWT with matching company_id and sub/agent id; missing or mismatched JWTs fail closed with agent_jwt_required or agent_scope_mismatch.
server_behavior.agent_lookup: agent must exist for (agentId, companyId), and persisted agents.permissions.trustPreset must be low_trust_review; request-body permissions are ignored and cannot grant limited-agent authority.

outbound_handoff.note: Inbound mission route authentication uses a scoped local agent JWT bound to company_id/sub. Outbound uses the DAAS shared secret, which remains server-side and is never exposed to the limited agent.

steps.assertion: paperclipRunId === null proves no internal Paperclip run was created; mission lives in DAAS.
steps.covered_by_test: daas-fork-security-regression.test.ts > 'allows a limited Paperclip agent to create a DAAS mission without creating an internal run'

steps.requirement: same agent is denied direct SSH, raw shell, and secret access
steps.covered_by_test: daas-fork-security-regression.test.ts > 'denies direct SSH, raw shell, and secret-intent tasks outside the DAAS mission route' / 'blocks raw process/http infrastructure adapters...' / 'asserts telemetry and dangerous connectors are disabled...'

steps.requirement: DAAS, not Paperclip, is the authoritative final mission status source AND the limited agent receives a DAAS evidence link

daasMission.evidenceUrl: <verbatim safe DAAS evidence URL, http(s) only; required for accepted handoff>

persisted_execution_state.daasMissionRouted_provenance: set ONLY when missionWasAcknowledged (real missionId AND routed_accepted AND ok AND safe evidenceUrl)

status_authority_sub_step.surfaced_status_effect: a surfaced DAAS status (blocked_by_policy / rejected / failed) sets issue.status = 'blocked' and ok = false

evidence_link_sub_step.requirement: limited agent receives a DAAS evidence link
evidence_link_sub_step.safe_url_example: An accepted mission persists e.g. 'https://daas.example.test/missions/mis_daas_limited/evidence' (illustrative host). If DAAS returns no safe evidence URL, Paperclip fails closed with daas_mission_evidence_required and does not create accepted route provenance.
evidence_link_sub_step.covered_by_test: daas-integrations.test.ts > 'exposes a safe DAAS evidence link on the limited-agent mission route' / 'uses a stable mission id and DAAS idempotency key for duplicate limited-route requests' / 'preserves existing issue execution state when persisting limited-route DAAS provenance' / 'fails closed before DAAS handoff when a supplied issue id is not company-scoped' / 'rejects issue ids assigned to a different agent before DAAS handoff' / 'requires issueId before DAAS handoff so accepted missions are durably persisted' / 'rejects spoofed limited permissions when the persisted agent is not limited' / 'rejects missing route agent JWTs' / 'rejects route agent JWTs scoped to a different company or agent' / limited-route issue persistence assertions / 'surfaces DAAS policy statuses on failed wrapper responses' blocked-state assertions / 'accepts shared DAAS in-progress statuses on the limited-agent mission route when safe evidence is present' / 'omits an unsafe DAAS evidence link with a query param from the route response' / 'fails closed when DAAS returns a cross-origin evidence link' / 'fails closed when DAAS returns an evidence link with an extra path token segment' / 'fails closed when the DAAS response envelope is not ok despite accepted-looking status' / handoffMissionToDaas 'returns a safe DAAS-provided evidence url on the accepted path' / 'omits an unsafe DAAS evidence url (userinfo), failing closed'; daas-fork-health.test.ts > 'documents the frontend-safe DAAS origin in the sidecar Docker build and runtime env'; daas-mission-adapter.test.ts > 'captures a DAAS-provided http(s) evidence url from an accepted response' / 'fails closed when a non-2xx DAAS response carries an accepted-looking body with evidence' / 'rejects accepted persisted states with a non-2xx HTTP status' / 'rejects an accepted DAAS response with an unsafe evidence url, failing closed' / 'does not mint DAAS route provenance from an unsafe evidence url even when ok is true' / readDaasMissionState negative-state read-back tests / 'captures a surfaced mission's evidence url from the links/evidence shape' / 'persists a DAAS evidence url into executionState.daasMission for the UI to render' / 'omits an unsafe DAAS evidence url from the persisted mission state' / parseDaasEvidenceUrl unit block incl. cross-origin, wrong-mission, path-token, userinfo, query, and fragment rejection; ui IssueOutputSection.test.tsx > DAAS evidence link render with configured frontend base / unsafe evidence URL omission; ui DaasMissionStatusCard.test.tsx > evidence-link render / no-render / configured non-example DAAS origin render / missing frontend DAAS base fails closed / 'drops a tampered unsafe evidence url (userinfo, query, or fragment)'
evidence_link_sub_step.executed: Focused server and UI suites were executed in the T275 worktree and passed; see m10-exit-gate.json executed_checks.
evidence_link_sub_step.how_proven: handoffMissionToDaas parses a safe evidence link and POST /api/integrations/paperclip/missions returns it as evidenceUrl on accepted responses, then persists the DAAS mission state to the issue when issueId is supplied and company-scoped. If DAAS accepts without a safe evidence link, the route returns daas_mission_evidence_required instead of handoff_accepted. PersistedDaasMissionState carries evidenceUrl: string | null, but buildDaasMissionExecutionState creates DAAS-route provenance only when missionId + routed_accepted + ok + safe evidenceUrl are all present. parseDaasEvidenceUrl reads evidence_url/evidenceUrl, evidence.{link,url,href}, links.{evidence,evidence_url,evidenceUrl} at envelope and data levels; readSafeEvidenceUrl accepts only an absolute http(s) URL from the configured DAAS origin with a bounded /missions/<mission-id>/evidence|proof|e path and no userinfo/query/fragment, and fails closed otherwise. The UI normalizeEvidenceUrl enforces the same configured-origin and mission-id-bound path contract before rendering; docker-compose.daas-sidecar.yml passes VITE_DAAS_BASE_URL to the Docker build and runtime env.
evidence_link_sub_step.test_result: PASS: server focused suite 88/88, UI focused suite 16/16, server typecheck passed.

steps.requirement: agent success text cannot override missing/failing proof
steps.invariant: DaasMissionAdapterDispatchResult.ok is true ONLY when DAAS returns an accepted/running status AND a non-empty mission id AND response.ok AND wrapperOk !== false. faked is the literal constant false on every return path.

negative_paths.condition: DAAS returns success-shaped text but no mission id

steps.covered_by_test: daas-mission-adapter.test.ts > 'does not treat success as accepted without DAAS evidence proof' / 'surfaces blocked_by_policy / rejected / awaiting_approval without faking success' / 'fails closed when DAAS accepts without returning a mission id' / 'fails closed when the DAAS response envelope explicitly says ok false'; daas-integrations.test.ts > 'fails closed when the DAAS response envelope is not ok despite accepted-looking status'

guarantees: Inbound route auth uses a scoped local agent JWT; the limited agent never receives the outbound DAAS shared secret.
Denial decision objects exclude the raw prompt text (only canonical signal names are retained).
Denial logs emit canonical signal names only, never the matched substring.
This evidence fixture itself uses <REDACTED_*> placeholders and synthetic hosts/ids.
steps.covered_by_test: daas-fork-security-regression.test.ts > 'keeps provider context free of raw secrets while routing secret-intent work to DAAS'
